name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trail. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
narrative.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
